meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或脚本变成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要做产品发布或推广视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create a product launch or promotional video

howto.what: 这个技能能让 Claude 根据产品链接、脚本或需求，自动规划并生成一个产品发布或推广视频。它会一步步完成从素材收集、设计、脚本到最终渲染的全流程。
howto.when: 当你提供产品/营销网址、粘贴脚本或提出推广需求时触发。也适用于网站导览或展示类请求。

say.text: 根据这段脚本，生成一个产品推广视频。
say.note: Claude 会使用你提供的脚本作为旁白。

say.text: 给我的网站做个展示视频：https://example.com
say.note: Claude 会捕获网站截图并制作导览视频。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to automatically plan and generate a product launch or promo video from a product link, pasted script, or brief. It handles the full workflow: asset capture, design system, storyboard, script, audio, frames, and final render.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a product/marketing URL, paste a script, or request a product promotion. Also handles site tours or showcase requests.

say_en.text: Create a launch video for this product: https://example.com/product
say_en.note: Claude will scrape the URL and start the video creation process.

say_en.text: Generate a promo video from this script.
say_en.note: Claude will use your script as the narration.

say_en.text: Make a site tour video for https://example.com
say_en.note: Claude will capture screenshots and create a walkthrough.
